title: Cloud Tenant Provisioning
scenario: NewVue Health has provisioned a new Microsoft 365 tenant to support its transition toward hybrid cloud services. The tenant creation process has been completed, and the system administrator must confirm that the environment is accessible, identify the correct administrative portals, complete the branding workflow, and verify that branding changes are visible to users. Because this is a complementary activity, use the scenario and reference information below to complete the administrative tasks.

activities.title: Administrative Access Workflow
activities.prompt: You need to confirm that the tenant environment is accessible after provisioning. Move the required actions into the Answer Area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Sign in using the administrator account
answer: Sign in using the administrator account
activities.explanation: Administrative access must be established before the tenant environment and subscription readiness can be confirmed.

activities.title: Administrative Portal Roles
activities.prompt: Match each administrative portal to the type of management it primarily provides in this deployment.
activities.explanation: Each portal is used for a different administrative scope in the Microsoft cloud environment.

activities.title: Branding Configuration Stages
activities.prompt: The organization wants to customize the sign-in experience. Move the branding configuration stages into the Answer Area and arrange them in the correct order.
activities.explanation: The branding wizard follows a staged workflow that moves from the initial branding details to final review.

activities.title: Branding Validation
activities.prompt: After completing the branding configuration, select the best method used to verify that the new sign-in experience is visible to users.
options: Open a private browser window and test the sign-in page
Create a new Azure virtual machine
activities.answer: Open a private browser window and test the sign-in page
activities.explanation: A private browser window avoids cached sessions and provides a cleaner validation of the sign-in experience.
